commitPolicy: Make a few small related changes per commit, verify the slice, stage only its files, use a short lowercase summary without body or attribution, and immediately push to origin/major-courses. Shared infrastructure extensions must be compatible and committed separately from course content. Record their hashes and integration requirements. Never push or merge into main from this task.
